descriptions.w3d_update_masked_caption_802c4744: For an active receiver with a nonempty name and caption interface, cast the held caption and hide it when its current text is empty. Otherwise set either the original text or a native temporary string assigned from the original 48-character mask literal using the original length, then show the caption. Preserve the original unchecked mask-length precondition, native temporary constructor and cleanup, and the helper-held source-text address across construction. Type and field roles are inferred partial external views. No complete owner layout or initialized-data ownership is claimed.
